decisions.reason: As a 2024 module that closely complements the core practice software and can be tested across the installed customer base at relatively low continuation cost, its upside is still uncertain enough to keep the option open despite limited market proof so far.

The secure healthcare messaging service is prominently positioned, tied to ongoing regulatory and telematics needs, and strategically important for an integrated dental IT suite, so the firm would likely continue rather than abandon it after only one year.
